title: Subspace Learning with Interval-Censored Likelihoods for Dequantizing Percept PC LFP Snapshots
abstract: arXiv:2609.22658v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Implanted neurostimulators that sense local field potentials now enable chronic electrophysiology based biomarker tracking in patients at home. The Medtronic Percept PC, the only commercially available sensing-enabled deep brain stimulation (DBS) device, stores spectral amplitudes as 16-bit integers at approximately 0.1 $\mu$V per bit (quantum $q \approx 0.11$ $\mu$Vp). At frequencies where the true amplitude spans only a few quantization levels, consecutive bins round to the same stored value. Standard spectral parameterization (FOOOF, fitting oscillations and one over f), which separates periodic peaks from the aperiodic 1/f activity, treats every value as exact and fits oscillatory peaks to these plateaus. Because these spectra feed clinical biomarker pipelines and spectral foundation models for symptom decoding, spurious peaks can corrupt downstream inference. Across 9,438 spectra from 14 hemispheres in 7 subcallosal cingulate DBS

translated_title: 基于区间删失似然的子空间学习用于Percept PC局部场电位快照的去量化
translated_abstract: 植入式神经刺激器如今能够感知局部场电位，使得基于慢性电生理学的生物标志物追踪能够在患者家中进行。Medtronic Percept PC是唯一一款市售的具备感知功能的脑深部电刺激（DBS）设备，它将频谱幅值以16位整数存储，分辨率约为每比特0.1 μV（量化步长 q ≈ 0.11 μVp）。在真实幅值仅跨越几个量化级别的频率处，相邻的频谱仓会四舍五入为相同的存储值。标准的频谱参数化方法（FOOOF，即拟合振荡与1/f），用于将周期性峰值与非周期性1/f活动分离，它将每个存储值视为精确值，并在这些量化平台上拟合出振荡峰。由于这些频谱会输入临床生物标志物分析流程以及用于症状解码的频谱基础模型，虚假峰值可能会破坏下游推断。研究使用了来自7名胼胝体下扣带回DBS患者14个大脑半球的9,438个频谱数据（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于区间删失似然的子空间学习方法，对Percept PC设备量化存储的LFP频谱快照进行去量化处理，以避免量化平台效应在FOOOF等频谱参数化中产生虚假振荡峰、破坏下游临床生物标志物推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a subspace learning approach with interval-censored likelihoods to dequantize Percept PC LFP spectral snapshots, preventing spurious oscillatory peaks caused by quantization plateaus from corrupting downstream clinical biomarker inference and symptom decoding.
